2610.08400.title: Atom-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for 3D Atomistic Systems
2610.08400.paper_summary: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining has reshaped modern machine learning, substantially advancing the ability of language and vision models to generalize across downstream tasks. While deep learning has driven considerable progress in modeling atomistic systems in recent years, self-supervised pretraining in this domain has not yet achieved comparable downstream generalization. To address this, we introduce Atom-JEPA, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns latent representations from unlabeled 3D structures through complementary atom-level and substructure-level objectives inspired by joint-embedding predictive architectures. We pretrain Atom-JEPA on large-scale molecular and crystalline datasets and evaluate its transfer performance by fine-tuning on a diverse set of downstream property prediction tasks. Atom-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance on molecular ADMET and quantum-chemical property prediction tasks, and is highly competitive in predicting the physical properties of crystalline materials. These results demonstrate the potential of latent-space predictive pretraining to support broad downstream generalization from structural data alone. Code and pretrained model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/khelverskovp/atom-jepa
2610.08400.paper_summary_zh: 大規模的自我監督預訓練重新塑造了現代機器學習，顯著提升了語言和視覺模型在下游任務中的泛化能力。雖然深度學習在最近幾年推動了原子系統建模的顯著進展，但在這一領域，自我監督預訓練尚未實現可比的下游泛化。為了解決這個問題，我們介紹了Atom-JEPA，一個自我監督預訓練框架，通過受聯合嵌入預測架構啟發的互補原子級和子結構級目標，從未標記的3D結構中學習潛在表示。我們在大規模的分子和晶體數據集上對Atom-JEPA進行預訓練，並通過在多樣化的下游性質預測任務上進行微調來評估其轉移性能。Atom-JEPA在分子ADMET和量子化學性質預測任務上達到了最先進的性能，並在預測晶體材料的物理性質方面具有很強的競爭力。這些結果展示了潛在空間預測預訓練支持僅從結構數據進行廣泛下游泛化的潛力。代碼和預訓練模型檢查點可在 https://github.com/khelverskovp/atom-jepa 上公開獲得。
